arxiv-2112-05935.title: Nonsmooth Control Barrier Function Design of Continuous Constraints for Network Connectivity Maintenance
arxiv-2112-05935.creator: Pio Ong, Beatrice Capelli, Lorenzo Sabattini, Jorge Cortés
arxiv-2112-05935.description: Abstract This paper considers the problem of maintaining global connectivity of a multi-robot system while executing a desired coordination task. Our approach builds on optimization-based feedback design formulations, where the nominal cost function and constraints encode desirable control objectives for the resulting input.

arxiv-2301-04800.title: Minimum Weight Random Graphs with Edge Constraints
arxiv-2301-04800.creator: Ghurumuruhan Ganesan 1 1 IISER, Bhopal E-mail: gganesan82@gmail.com
arxiv-2301-04800.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper, we study two examples of minimum weight random graphs with edge constraints. First we consider the complete graph on n vertices equipped with uniformly heavy edge weights and use iteration methods to obtain deviation estimates for the minimum weight of subtrees with a given number of edges.

arxiv-2302-02333.title: Learning in Quantum Games
arxiv-2302-02333.creator: Kyriakos Lotidis ∗, Panayotis Mertikopoulos ♯, Nicholas Bambos ‡
arxiv-2302-02333.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kyriakos Lotidis ∗, Panayotis Mertikopoulos ♯, Nicholas Bambos ‡. In this paper, we introduce a class of learning dynamics for general quantum games, that we call FTQL ( FTQL ), in reference to the classical FTRL template for finite games.

arxiv-2302-05556.title: Higher-Order Allan Variance for Atomic Clocks of Arbitrary Order: Mathematical Foundation
arxiv-2302-05556.creator: Takayuki Ishizaki, Taichi Ichimura, Takahiro Kawaguchi, Yuichiro Yano, Yuko Hanado
arxiv-2302-05556.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Takayuki Ishizaki, Taichi Ichimura, Takahiro Kawaguchi, Yuichiro Yano, Yuko Hanado. In this paper, we perform a time-domain analysis of the higher-order Allan variance for atomic clock models of arbitrary order. Adopting a standard atomic clock model where the time series of the clock reading deviation is expressed as a Wiener or integrated Wiener process, we define the higher-order Allan variance as the mean squared higher-order difference of the clock reading deviation. The main results of this paper are threefold.

arxiv-2406-00156.title: Holographic description of an anisotropic Dirac semimetal
arxiv-2406-00156.creator: Sebastián Bahamondes, Ignacio Salazar Landea, Rodrigo Soto-Garrido
arxiv-2406-00156.description: Abstract Holographic quantum matter exploits the AdS/CFT correspondence to study systems in condensed matter physics. An example of these systems are strongly correlated semimetals, which feature a rich phase diagram structure. In this work, we present a holographic model for a Dirac semimetal in 2 + 1 2+1 dimensions that features a topological phase transition.

arxiv-2406-08062.description: Abstract . The combinatorial Loewner property was introduced by Bourdon and Kleiner as a quasisymmetrically invariant substitute for the Loewner property for general fractals and boundaries of hyperbolic groups. While the Loewner property is somewhat restrictive, the combinatorial Loewner property is very generic – Bourdon and Kleiner showed that many familiar fractals and group boundaries satisfy it.

arxiv-2406-13181.title: The Impact of Auxiliary Patient Data on Automated Chest X-Ray Report Generation and How to Incorporate It
arxiv-2406-13181.creator: Aaron Nicolson, Shengyao Zhuang, Jason Dowling, & Bevan Koopman
arxiv-2406-13181.description: Abstract This study investigates the integration of diverse patient data sources into multimodal language models for automated chest X-ray (CXR) report generation. Traditionally, CXR report generation relies solely on CXR images and limited radiology data, overlooking valuable information from patient health records, particularly from emergency departments.

arxiv-2407-10822.creator: M. E. Henderson, D. G. Cory, D. Sarenac, D. A. Pushin
arxiv-2407-10822.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. E. Henderson, D. G. Cory, D. Sarenac, D. A. Pushin. Topological magnetism has sparked an unprecedented age in quantum technologies. arxiv-2411-02763.description: Abstract Nonlinear relations, such as the curvilinear relationship between childhood trauma and resilience in patients with schizophrenia and the moderation relationship between mentalizing, and internalizing/externalizing symptoms and quality of life in youths, are more prevalent than our current methods have been able to detect.

arxiv-2504-05008.title: Surveying Professional Writers on AI: Limitations, Expectations, and Fears
arxiv-2504-05008.creator: Anastasiia Ivanova, Natalia Fedorova, Sergey Tilga, Ekaterina Artemova
arxiv-2504-05008.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anastasiia Ivanova, Natalia Fedorova, Sergey Tilga, Ekaterina Artemova. The rapid development of AI-driven tools, particularly large language models (LLMs), is reshaping professional writing. Still, key aspects of their adoption such as languages support, ethics, and long-term impact on writers voice and creativity remain underexplored. In this work, we conducted a questionnaire ( N = 301 N=301 ) and an interactive survey ( N = 36 N=36 ) targeting professional writers regularly using AI.

arxiv-2507-17884.title: Search for resonant production of pairs of dijet resonances through broad mediators in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2507-17884.description: Abstract A reinterpretation of a prior narrow-resonance search is performed to investigate the resonant production of pairs of dijet resonances via broad mediators. This analysis targets events with four resolved jets, requiring dijet invariant masses greater than 0.2 \TeV and four-jet invariant masses greater than 1.6 \TeV .

arxiv-2511-04320.title: MacroNav: Multi-Task Context Representation Learning Enables Efficient Navigation in Unknown Environments
arxiv-2511-04320.creator: Kuankuan Sima, Longbin Tang, Haozhe Ma, Lin Zhao
arxiv-2511-04320.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kuankuan Sima, Longbin Tang, Haozhe Ma, Lin Zhao. Autonomous navigation in unknown environments requires compact yet expressive spatial understanding under partial observability to support high-level decision making. Existing approaches struggle to balance rich contextual representation with navigation efficiency. We present MacroNav , a learning-based navigation framework featuring two key components: (1) a lightweight context encoder trained via multi-task self-supervised learning to capture multi-scale, navigation-centric spatial representations; and (2) a reinforcement learning policy that seamlessly integrates these representations with graph-based reasoning for efficient action selection.

govdocs-nsarchive-Briefing_Book_intellig.title: Did Nixon Even Read the CIA’s Daily Briefs?
govdocs-nsarchive-Briefing_Book_intellig.creator: National Security Archive
govdocs-nsarchive-Briefing_Book_intellig.description: Washington D.C., September 14, 2016 - President Richard Nixon may never have even read the President’s Daily Briefs partially declassified and released by the CIA with great fanfare on August 24, 2016. The CIA’s claim that the PDBs were “the primary vehicle for summarizing the day-to-day sensitive intelligence and analysis … for the White House” is partly true, but Nixon’s prejudices against the Agency and the distinctive role of national security adviser Henry Kissinger suggest that his cover memos to the PDBs were far more important to the President than whatever the CIA had to say.
